description: Create a credit note against an existing invoice, reducing the amount owed. Requires Finance role or above.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

credit_amount.description: Total credit amount (required, must be > 0 and ≤ invoice total).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

invoice_id.description: ID of the invoice to credit (required).

name: create_credit_note
